samples.question: The round badge shows the starting state as one, two, or three pips. Apply the square badge first, then the diamond badge. In each rule badge, the pips left of the divider are the match state and the pips right of the divider are the replacement: replace the current state only when it matches the left group; otherwise keep it. After both rules, is the state one, two, or three?
